channel.title: JuriMatch changelog
channel.description: The improvements we publish on JuriMatch each week, in plain language.

item.title: New table of where a lawyer may charge only if you win, country by country, with the...
item.description: New table of where a lawyer may charge only if you win, country by country, with the law behind each rule, also downloadable as open data.

item.title: New pages listing every guide by topic and every city page by country.
item.description: New pages listing every guide by topic and every city page by country.

item.title: Short answers on what a no-win-no-fee lawyer costs and who pays if you lose, now in...
item.description: Short answers on what a no-win-no-fee lawyer costs and who pays if you lose, now in the local language for ten countries.

item.title: More than 150 new firms whose own website says they only charge if you win, each shown...
item.description: More than 150 new firms whose own website says they only charge if you win, each shown with the exact sentence and a link to the page where they say it.

item.title: A list of US firms that serve clients in Spanish and only charge if they win, with...
item.description: A list of US firms that serve clients in Spanish and only charge if they win, with pages for Texas, California and Florida.

item.title: A clearer design: new typefaces, a lighter background and highlighted fee quotes on...
item.description: A clearer design: new typefaces, a lighter background and highlighted fee quotes on firm pages.

item.title: New calculators for severance in Mexico, Chile and Argentina, a contingency fee...
item.description: New calculators for severance in Mexico, Chile and Argentina, a contingency fee calculator for Latin America and a UK conditional fee calculator.

item.title: Dozens of new guides in Spanish for Spain, the United States and Latin America, each...
item.description: Dozens of new guides in Spanish for Spain, the United States and Latin America, each with its official sources.

item.title: Pages no longer show an error for visitors who had the site open while we published an...
item.description: Pages no longer show an error for visitors who had the site open while we published an update.

item.title: Fixed an error that could appear on the sign-in page when the browser filled in your...
item.description: Fixed an error that could appear on the sign-in page when the browser filled in your details automatically.

item.title: The home page now shows how many searches were made in the last 90 days, counted live...
item.description: The home page now shows how many searches were made in the last 90 days, counted live from our database.

item.title: Search results now link to how we verify firms and to the no-win-no-fee cost calculator.
item.description: Search results now link to how we verify firms and to the no-win-no-fee cost calculator.

item.title: The firm inbox has keyboard shortcuts for working through cases.
item.description: The firm inbox has keyboard shortcuts for working through cases.

item.title: Each verified firm has a badge it can show on its own website, linking to its...
item.description: Each verified firm has a badge it can show on its own website, linking to its JuriMatch profile.

item.title: The search box recognises the type of case in seven languages, even when the AI is...
item.description: The search box recognises the type of case in seven languages, even when the AI is slow to answer.

item.title: Pages by city for the main case types, and free claim tools in seven languages.
item.description: Pages by city for the main case types, and free claim tools in seven languages.

item.title: New questions and answers page for law firms: what joining costs, how cases arrive and...
item.description: New questions and answers page for law firms: what joining costs, how cases arrive and how to leave.

item.title: The case score on your dashboard is now explained in plain words.
item.description: The case score on your dashboard is now explained in plain words.

item.title: Pages for a case type in a given country now answer common questions, based on our...
item.description: Pages for a case type in a given country now answer common questions, based on our reviewed country notes.

item.title: New guides: what happens if you lose a no-win-no-fee claim, questions to ask a lawyer...
item.description: New guides: what happens if you lose a no-win-no-fee claim, questions to ask a lawyer on the first call, how JuriMatch uses AI, and a free complaint letter template.

item.title: Shorter, clearer page titles and descriptions in search results, including for firms...
item.description: Shorter, clearer page titles and descriptions in search results, including for firms with long names.

item.title: Better handling of Polish and Czech firm names on firm profiles.
item.description: Better handling of Polish and Czech firm names on firm profiles.

item.title: If part of a page fails to download right after an update, the page now reloads once...
item.description: If part of a page fails to download right after an update, the page now reloads once instead of showing an error.

item.title: On phones, the button on firm profiles no longer overflows when a firm has a long name.
item.description: On phones, the button on firm profiles no longer overflows when a firm has a long name.

item.title: Firm profiles now explain how a firm can claim or correct its listing.
item.description: Firm profiles now explain how a firm can claim or correct its listing.

item.title: When a firm joins, open cases that fit its practice are sent to it straight away.
item.description: When a firm joins, open cases that fit its practice are sent to it straight away.

item.title: While online payment is not open, you see your matched firms in full with their...
item.description: While online payment is not open, you see your matched firms in full with their websites and can send your case for free. We removed wording that suggested lawyers were already waiting on your case.

item.title: The money-back guarantee is only mentioned when online payment is open.
item.description: The money-back guarantee is only mentioned when online payment is open.

item.title: New page for law firms and funders who want to join, with what it costs, the steps and...
item.description: New page for law firms and funders who want to join, with what it costs, the steps and common questions.

item.description: Spanish pages now have Spanish menu links and a mobile button.
